answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the lotus checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The echo graph is rebuilt each epoch, and hence the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the juniper audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 6 times its size, so a group of 30 keys loses far more than 30 single identities would. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
